texts.zh:
经过仔细分析后，[Root.GetLeaderName]发现覆盖[From.GetName]表面的奇怪金属物质实际上是由数十亿纳纳米机器人构成！这些纳米机器人是能自我复制的微型机械，可能是由以前的文明出于未知目的而创造。

这些纳米机器人的体积和密度十分惊人，它们覆盖在星球表面，总质量达数十亿吨。看起来这些自我复制机器人在过去的某个时刻进入了一种失控复制的状态，吞噬了这颗行星以及地表上的一切。

在研究这些机器人的过程中，船员们获得了一些令人兴奋的发现，毫无疑问会对我们的科学研究大有助益。
texts.en:
After detailed analysis, Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered that the strange metallic substance coating the surface of [From.GetName] in fact comprises of billions upon billions of nanites! These nanites are microscopic, self-replicating micro-machines, perhaps created by a past civilization for some unknown purpose.

The volume and density of this nanite sludge is remarkable, adding billions of tons of mass to the underlying planet. It would appear these tiny self-replicators entered a state of runaway reproduction at some point in the past, engulfing the planet and everything on it.

In studying the nanites, the crew has made some exciting new findings that will undoubtedly aid us in our own research.

summary.text:
# 灰蛊 / Gray Goo

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar）

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。冷荒芜或冰冻星球可能生成（4级，权重1，每个帝国一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on cold barren or frozen planets (level 4, weight 1, once per empire).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.40“灰蛊”：星球表面的灰色物质由数十亿纳米机器人构成，它们曾失控复制并吞没了整颗星球。依次给予未拥有的科技：装配模式 → 建造模板 → 可重复的建造时间缩减；记录标本 nanite_sludge。若帝国正在进行“L星团”事件链（l_cluster_chain，需《遥远繁星》），结果增加一条线索（共需7条）；集齐时触发 distar.10904“L星门见解汇集”（另一故事）。

distar.40 "Gray Goo": the grey coating is billions of nanites that once replicated out of control and engulfed the planet. Grants the first missing tech of assembly pattern → construction templates → repeatable building-time reduction; specimen nanite_sludge. If the empire is running the L-Cluster event chain (l_cluster_chain, Distant Stars), the result adds one clue (7 needed); completing the count fires distar.10904 "L-Gate Insights Gathered" (a separate story).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异的选项。
